notes: Identity checked independently: supplied text gives The Temporal Pattern to the Experience of Regret, Thomas Gilovich and Victoria Husted Medvec, Journal of Personality and Social Psychology, 1994, Vol. 67, No. 3, 357–365. Title/authors/year/volume/pages match the neutral original reference. The DOI is not printed in the supplied text and was not independently resolved. This is an original empirical journal article, not the 2022 replication or a preregistration. Text spans pp. 357–365 but contains an incomplete Study 4 statistical line; no PDF was supplied for layout verification. Canonical text remains the evidence source. Only assigned unfinished fields are populated; other fields are unassigned placeholders. Target ambiguity: the explicit Study 4 design concerns Dave/Jim transfer-versus-stay judgments between two time perspectives, whereas the description could imply personal lifetime action-versus-inaction judgments (Study 1 or the lifetime component of Study 5). No target was selected by row order or matching numbers. Candidate Study 4 between-subject scenario model only: 34 short-term respondents + 42 long-run respondents = 76 participants across explicitly separate groups. No exclusions are stated. This does not establish N for a uniquely matched life-regret target; 76 is deliberately not entered in n.value. The canonical text stops the Study 4 inferential result after "x 2 (0 ="; it gives no usable coefficient or numeric p on that line. No source PDF is supplied, so the incomplete OCR cannot be resolved within the permitted materials. Do not infer a chi-square value from the group sizes or percentages, and do not substitute the Study 3 binomial statistics or Study 5 values.
